crossRefs.note: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

translations.web: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”
translations.bsb: Aren’t all His sisters with us as well? Where then did this man get all these things?”
translations.kjv: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
